instruction: Add a right-aligned tab stop at 15 cm to all paragraphs in the document.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the target .docx file via env.controller.get_file and extracts tab stops from all non-empty paragraphs, including position in cm and alignment.

Metric correctly handles the type='rule' expected parameter by accessing expected.get('position_cm', 15.0), expected.get('alignment', 'RIGHT'), and expected.get('tolerance_cm', 0.5) directly — no nested .get('rules') error.
RIGHT/END OOXML alignment aliases are properly handled, ensuring compatibility with different OOXML writers.
Proportional scoring (matching/len(paragraphs)) correctly enforces 'all paragraphs' requirement — returns 1.0 only when every non-empty paragraph has the right-aligned tab stop.
Postconfig issues Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the file is saved and getter reads fresh state.
Negative-control resistant: initial document has no explicit tab stops, so the metric returns 0.0 on the unmodified document.

Minor: getter uses doc.paragraphs which covers only top-level paragraphs, not text inside table cells. If the document contains tabular content that should also receive the tab stop, those would not be checked.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optionally extend the getter to also iterate paragraphs inside table cells (via doc.tables) for more complete coverage if the document contains text in tables.

Deviated at step 12 when attempting to manually insert tab characters into each sentence.

At step 12 the agent began triple-clicking individual lines to manually edit tab characters, which was not required. The task simplification anchors on the successful prefix: setting tab stops via the dialog.
metadata.task_rationale: The reliable prefix (steps 0-11) shows the agent successfully added a right tab stop at 15 cm. This variation tests exactly that outcome, anchored to the demonstrated actions.
metadata.explanation: Getter reads the .docx file via python-docx and extracts tab stop position/alignment for each non-empty paragraph. Metric checks that every non-empty paragraph has a right-aligned (or END-aliased) tab stop within 0.5 cm of 15 cm. Initial document has no explicit tab stops, so the initial state scores 0.0 (negative-control resistant).

scoring_breakdown.tabstop_check: 1.0 if all non-empty paragraphs have right tab at ~15 cm, proportional partial credit otherwise
